value.rationale: This identifies every possible linear dimension of an element centralizer, the frequency of all six types, and a uniform exact commuting probability for a natural noncommutative finite-dimensional associative algebra. The 6-generator case exhibits the nondecomposable 3-vector one-line annihilator layer, giving new centralizer dimensions absent from smaller odd-generator principal-unit questions. The stratification is structural rather than an arbitrary finite enumeration and motivates study of centralizer distributions in higher exterior algebras.
